_: The films (tools/make_films.py): per film the music cue the game plays under it and its shots. A shot: the picture (FLUX.2, photographic; refs = portraits it takes faces from), the motion (LTX-2.3, image to video), what is said over it ([speaker, text key], German and English in assets/text/<lang>/films.txt) and, if the lines need more, its length in seconds; its id names its files (shots put in later do not move the others). The style is added to every picture.
style: Realistic photograph, full frame, shot on 35mm film with natural grain, realistic practical lighting, muted desaturated colours, deep shadows, gritty industrial science fiction set in a far future among spaceships and space stations, only fictional insignia and logos, high detail.
motion: Cinematic, photographic, realistic motion, subtle film grain, steady professional camera.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A moon in deep space half cut away by giant mining machines, its glowing orange interior exposed, swarms of mining lights crawling over the cut, a dim red star behind it.
shots.motion: Very slow push towards the cut moon, mining lights crawl and flicker.

shots.picture: Deep space. A long chain of small refugee ships braking with bright blue-white fusion flames, strung out in a line in front of a gigantic dim red dwarf star that fills half the frame. Black sky, faint stars.
shots.motion: Very slow drift of the camera along the chain of ships, the fusion flames flicker and pulse.

shots.picture: Science fiction, in deep space, black starry void, no water, no sea: an old overloaded rusty cargo spacecraft, a boxy frame of girders with dozens of strapped-on steel freight containers, no keel and no deck, patched hull plates, thruster nozzles with a weak braking flame, red starlight on its flank.
shots.motion: Slow push-in towards the spacecraft, the braking flame flickers, tiny lights blink on the containers.

shots.picture: Science fiction: inside a cramped steel cargo module of a spaceship converted into living space, colonists of mixed origins in padded grey thermal jumpsuits with utility harnesses and clip-on breathing masks, strapped into fold-down webbing seats against the walls, glowing amber light strips along the ceiling, an air scrubber unit with blinking status lights, frost and condensation on riveted walls, tired faces.
shots.motion: Static shot from a tripod, the camera does not move at all. The colonists sit still in their seats, strapped in, their backs against the wall; they only breathe and blink.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Close-up of an old man's weathered hands in a padded grey thermal suit holding a scratched metal identity tag on a cord, inside a cramped spaceship cargo module lit by amber light strips.
shots.motion: The hands turn the tag slowly, amber light flickers.

shots.picture: A small nine-year-old child, a girl with a round childish face and short dark hair, wearing an oversized adult jacket, sitting at a small round porthole, her face lit dark red by the light of a star outside, quiet and tired.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on the girl, she blinks and looks out of the porthole, red light moves softly over her face.

shots.picture: View through a scratched round porthole into space: among the stars one point of light is unusually bright, a small white glare, with the red dwarf glowing at the edge of the frame.
shots.motion: Very slow zoom towards the bright point of light, it pulses faintly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The cramped cockpit of an old cargo spaceship, a woman pilot in her thirties in a worn grey flight suit with a faded patch of a fictional freight company and no flags or national insignia, headset on, at the controls, red warning lights blinking, radar screens with two small contacts, tense.
shots.motion: The pilot leans forward and works the controls, warning lights blink.

shots.picture: Science fiction, in deep space, black starry void, no water: a sleek white patrol spacecraft of an advanced civilisation, a smooth seamless elongated shape like a polished stone, no windows, no masts, no decks, hanging motionless far away, cold soft lights along its hull, utterly clean, watching.
shots.motion: The spacecraft hangs still, the camera slowly circles it, its lights glow steadily.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The bridge of an advanced spaceship, pure white and empty, smooth curved walls, a single soft sphere of light hovering in the middle, a large window looking out into black deep space full of stars, far away in the darkness a small battered colony freighter spacecraft, a boxy rusty hull of riveted cargo modules with thruster nozzles and antenna masts. No water, no sea, no sky.
shots.motion: The sphere of light pulses softly, the camera drifts slowly.

shots.picture: Science fiction, in deep space, black starry void all around, no water, no sea, no planet: black angular raider spacecraft with harpoon lines and grappling claws closing in on the hull of a battered colony freighter spacecraft, a long boxy hull of riveted rusty cargo modules with thruster nozzles, the claws about to bite into the hull plates, sparks.
shots.motion: Weightless in space, the raider craft glide towards the hull, harpoon lines shoot out and snap taut, sparks fly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Masked raiders in dark angular armour with glowing visors cutting through a spaceship airlock door with a plasma cutter, sparks spraying, one holds a handheld neural scanner with a glowing ring.
shots.motion: Sparks spray, the airlock door gives way, the raiders push forward.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A cyborg figure in a heavy dark armoured utility suit slumped against the wall of a dark red-lit server cellar of a space station, its face hidden by a cracked helmet, thick cables plugged into its back, six empty connection cradles beside it.
shots.motion: Slow push-in, a red light blinks on the cracked helmet.

shots.picture: A long vault of glass storage cylinders in steel racks, cold blue light, every cylinder empty and dark, frost on the glass, a row of small labels for children's cores, empty.
shots.motion: Slow dolly along the empty racks, frost glitters, a light flickers.

shots.picture: A dusty basement storage room full of cable bundles, in the middle an old ship's computer core the size of a wardrobe, scratched, wired up as a data store, one weak amber status light.
shots.motion: Slow push-in towards the computer core, its amber light pulses like breathing.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A shabby space station bar at night, a woman in her sixties writing a new name with chalk on a large board full of place names, workers at the counter watching silently.
shots.motion: She writes slowly with the chalk, the workers watch.

shots.picture: An old battered survey spaceship in the dock of a huge rotating space station, its hull covered in welded patches and scorch marks, dock floodlights, workers' scaffolding.
shots.motion: The camera rises slowly along the hull, floodlights sweep across it, sparks drift.

shots.picture: An elegant woman in her mid-fifties with silver hair pinned up, dark tailored coat, in a dim luxurious apartment with old books, holding out a small data chip between two fingers, calm, tired, friendly eyes.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on the woman, she holds out the chip and smiles faintly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The worn cockpit of an old survey spaceship, patched consoles, a small spherical sensor eye glowing amber in the middle of the dashboard, stars through the scratched window.
shots.motion: The amber sensor eye brightens, consoles flicker on one after another.

shots.picture: A small battered spaceship undocking from a gigantic rotating drum-shaped space station, city lights inside the drum's windows, engines glowing blue.
shots.motion: The ship drifts away from the station, its engines brighten, the station turns slowly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A gigantic rotating drum-shaped space station seen from far away, its windows glowing, and close beside it in the black sky a bright white point of light.
shots.motion: The station turns slowly, the camera pulls back.

shots.picture: A tiny spaceship against a dark starfield, far ahead one star-like point burns much brighter than all the others, with a faint smudge around it.
shots.motion: The ship moves slowly away from the camera towards the bright point.

shots.picture: Science fiction, in deep space, black starry void all around, no water, no sea: a small battered survey spaceship clamped onto a long skeletal space freighter, a lattice spine of girders with frosted cargo pods, a figure in a space suit floating beside it and cutting into a pod with a torch, sparks.
shots.motion: Sparks fly from the torch, the two ships drift together through space.

shots.picture: Seen through a large frosted window: a gigantic grey moon that has been cut open and hollowed out like an empty shell, its inside glowing orange, a ring of enormous rocket engines built onto its rim, and in front of it a wide fan of glowing molten rock streaming out into space. No ships.
shots.motion: Very slow push towards the window, the ore fan glows and drifts.

shots.picture: A cold cargo hold with endless rows of racks holding thousands of small glowing control core cylinders, each with a faint blue light, frost, darkness beyond.
shots.motion: Slow dolly through the racks, the core lights pulse gently, one after another.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Close-up of a single glowing control core cylinder in a cargo rack, frost on the glass, inside it a faint pattern of light like a slowly breathing wave.
shots.motion: The light inside the core pulses slowly, frost glitters.

shots.picture: Deep space: two sleek black angular warships with thin white edge lights hanging silently beside a long ugly space freighter, a skeletal lattice spine with hundreds of frosted cargo pods clamped to it and a small engine block at the end. Black starry sky, no planet, no water.
shots.motion: The black ships slide into frame and stop, completely still and silent.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The dark bridge of a black warship in deep space, no crew visible, only a single cold white light and a closed-eye emblem engraved on the wall, through the window a long skeletal space freighter with frosted cargo pods floating among the stars.
shots.motion: The cold light brightens slowly, the emblem catches it.

shots.picture: Deep space: thin beams of blinding white light cutting through a long skeletal space freighter with frosted cargo pods on a lattice spine, the lattice splitting apart silently, pods tumbling, debris and frost spraying out. Black starry sky, no water.
shots.motion: The beams sweep across the hull, it breaks apart slowly, debris tumbles.

shots.picture: Close-up of rows of small glowing control cores in a cargo rack, their blue lights going out one by one, darkness spreading.
shots.motion: The lights go out one by one along the row until only one is left.

shots.picture: Science fiction: pure blinding white light flooding everything, the faint silhouette of a long skeletal space freighter with cargo pods on a lattice spine dissolving in it.
shots.motion: The white light grows until it fills the whole frame.

shots.picture: Science fiction: An elderly gaunt engineer with a thin grey beard sitting in a stark prison cell behind a wall of faint blue energy bars, hands folded, calm and tired.
shots.motion: Slow push-in through the energy bars, they flicker.

shots.picture: An elderly gaunt engineer in his seventies with deep lines and a thin grey beard in a sterile white laboratory, looking at a translucent holographic scan of a human brain with one thin red thread of light running through it.
shots.motion: Slow push-in, the hologram turns slowly, the red thread glows brighter.

shots.picture: Macro view of a vast network of glowing fibres, a pale cold pattern spreading through it like frost, extinguishing the lights it touches.
shots.motion: The frost pattern spreads quickly through the network, lights go out behind it.

shots.picture: An elegant woman in her mid-fifties with silver hair pinned up, dark tailored coat, standing calm in the doorway of a white corridor, backlit, hands folded.
shots.motion: She stands still, the camera slowly pushes in on her calm face.

shots.picture: A long row of glowing medical capsules, body printers, with a small engraved emblem of a closed eye on each, soft white light, empty.
shots.motion: Slow dolly along the capsules, their lights breathe softly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A person in a battered grey space suit with plain fictional patches and a closed helmet seen from behind, standing before a dark mirror-like glass wall on a space station, their reflection faint.
shots.motion: The figure stands still, the reflection wavers.

shots.picture: An elderly gaunt engineer with a thin grey beard working at an open server rack with tools, determined, cables everywhere, cold light.
shots.motion: The engineer works quickly, the rack's lights flicker.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Inside a rotating space station drum, people in worn colony clothes packing belongings onto carts in a crowded street, cargo lifts, worried faces, emergency lights.
shots.motion: People hurry past with bundles and carts, lights blink.

shots.picture: From a street inside a huge rotating space station drum, people look up: through the drum's great window a colossal hollowed moon with engines fills half the sky, glowing ore streaming from it.
shots.motion: The camera tilts slowly up from the people to the colossal moon in the sky.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A gloved hand hovering over a glowing console key in a dark server hall, the key lit soft blue, rows of server racks behind.
shots.motion: The hand lowers slowly onto the glowing key.

shots.picture: A woman around forty with short dark hair and a calm tired face, sitting at a worn kitchen table in a strange patchwork hall made from a mine canteen, a classroom and a kitchen, soft warm light, she closes her eyes.
shots.motion: Slow push-in, she closes her eyes and smiles faintly.

shots.picture: An endless hall of workplaces stretching into the distance, thousands of small warm lights, and the lights are going out row by row.
shots.motion: The rows of lights go out one after another towards the camera.

shots.picture: Inside a hollowed moon: a gigantic furnace like a small artificial sun hanging in the centre, rivers of molten metal on the walls, the sun dimming and cooling to dark red.
shots.motion: The furnace dims slowly, the molten rivers darken and stop.

shots.picture: A shabby station bar at night, a woman in her sixties behind the counter wiping a name off a large chalk board full of names of places, and writing a new name in chalk: ILKA.
shots.motion: She wipes the board slowly and writes with chalk.

shots.picture: Science fiction: An elegant woman in her mid-fifties with silver hair pinned up, dark coat, sitting alone at a table of a shabby space station bar with a glass, silent, eyes lowered.
shots.motion: She sits still and turns the glass slowly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A rotating drum-shaped space station intact in space, and beside it a colossal hollowed moon with engines, dark and still, its furnace out.
shots.motion: Slow drift past the station, the dark moon hangs motionless.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A gigantic ring-shaped jump gate under construction in deep space, scaffolding and work lights, ships ferrying girders, distant stars.
shots.motion: Work lights blink, a ship carries a girder slowly across.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Antenna masts on the grey rock-and-steel outer hull of a hollowed-out moon in deep space, sending bright streams of data light out to the stars.
shots.motion: The streams of light shoot out into space one after another.

shots.picture: Thousands of screens in the streets and halls of shining white space cities, all showing the same grainy footage of people at work in a strange hall, crowds of citizens standing still and watching.
shots.motion: Slow pan across the screens and the silent crowd.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A shining white city on a space habitat, elegant citizens in white clothes standing still in a plaza, a woman holding her hand over her mouth, watching a huge screen.
shots.motion: The citizens stand frozen, the woman lowers her hand slowly.

shots.picture: A vast empty white hall without walls, hundreds of tall slender pillars of soft white light standing in a wide circle on a polished floor, nothing else in the hall, one pillar dimmer than the others. Abstract, calm, silent.
shots.motion: The camera glides slowly through the circle of light pillars, one of them fades.

shots.picture: People waking in clean medical capsules, new bodies, a woman around forty with short dark hair sitting up and looking at her own hands in wonder.
shots.motion: She sits up slowly and looks at her hands.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The worn cockpit of an old survey spaceship, a small spherical sensor eye glowing amber on the dashboard, an official document shown on a screen.
shots.motion: The amber eye pulses, the document on the screen scrolls.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A sleek angular spaceship floating in the huge pressurised dock of a space station, being repainted from black to white by hovering drones, its crew in grey uniforms standing unchanged on a gantry, stars through the dock's open mouth.
shots.motion: Drones spray white paint across the black hull.

shots.picture: A clean rebuilt street inside a rotating space station drum, ten years later, gardens and new houses, a man standing in the street and looking up, unsure.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on the man, people walk past in the background.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Close-up of a woman around forty with short dark hair opening her eyes in a soft patchwork hall, calm, a faint smile, people working behind her.
shots.motion: She opens her eyes slowly and looks into the camera.

shots.picture: A woman around forty with short dark hair and a calm determined face at a large control console in a vast patchwork hall, hundreds of people around her at their stations, streams of code light flowing towards her.
shots.motion: The code streams flow in, she lays her hand on the console, people turn towards her.

shots.picture: A colossal hollowed moon with engines in space, the glowing fan of ore in front of it fading out, the cutting beams switching off one by one.
shots.motion: The ore fan fades, the beams go dark one after another.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Rows of sleek white warships lining up at the edge of a star system, a blockade in deep space, distant red star.
shots.motion: The warships hold their line, lights blink along their hulls.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The worn cockpit of an old survey spaceship, a small spherical sensor eye glowing amber on the dashboard, a colossal moon visible through the window.
shots.motion: The amber eye pulses, the moon drifts past the window.

shots.picture: An elegant woman in her mid-fifties with silver hair pinned up, dark coat, standing at a large window of a space station, looking up at a colossal moon in the sky, wry, tired smile.
shots.motion: Slow push-in, she smiles faintly and shakes her head.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A poor but busy street inside a rotating space station drum, people in worn colony clothes looking up at a colossal moon hanging peacefully in the sky.
shots.motion: People stop and look up, the moon hangs still.

shots.picture: A colossal hollowed moon igniting its huge engines, blue-white flames blooming at its rim, beginning to move away into the dark.
shots.motion: The engines ignite and grow brighter, the moon slowly moves away.

shots.picture: Rain-soaked narrow tunnels of a space station's underworld at night, flickering neon signs, steam from grates, puddles reflecting red and green light.
shots.motion: Slow tracking shot through the rain, steam rises, neon flickers.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A heavy-set man in his sixties in an expensive coat counting glowing control core cylinders on a back-room table in a space station underworld, smiling, cigar smoke.
shots.motion: He counts the cylinders and smiles, smoke drifts.

shots.picture: A handheld neural scanner with a glowing ring lying on a scratched metal table in a back room, next to stacks of cash chips, a single lamp.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on the device, its ring glows softly.

shots.picture: A man in his early thirties in a dark hooded coat standing in the rain at the door of a cramped family quarter, light from inside on his face, hesitating.
shots.motion: He stands still in the rain, then lowers his eyes.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Close-up of a small child's hand clutching a tiny toy robot with one leg, in a cramped spaceship family quarter, dim warm light.
shots.motion: The small hand tightens around the toy.

shots.picture: A man in a dark coat walking away down a rainy neon tunnel, seen from behind, a small device lying in a drain behind him.
shots.motion: He walks away into the rain and the steam.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Rain running down the window of a station tram at night, a man in a dark coat reflected in the glass, neon lights passing outside.
shots.motion: Rain streaks down, lights slide past outside.

shots.picture: A heavy-gravity mining world: squat massive industrial domes and conveyor towers under a low ochre sky, dust in the air, everything built low and thick.
shots.motion: Slow pan across the squat domes, dust drifts.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A short broad young woman in a heavy mining suit sitting quietly beside a big bearded miner who hums a song softly with closed eyes, both calm and tired, warming their hands at a glowing heater coil in a heavy-gravity mining camp at night, dust in the air.
shots.motion: The miner hums with closed eyes, the heater glows, dust drifts slowly.

shots.picture: Short broad miners in makeshift armour made of mining suit plates behind a barricade of ore carts, holding blasting charges and hammers, determined faces, dust.
shots.motion: The miners crouch and wait, dust drifts past, one checks a charge.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A column of clean white vehicles and hovering drones of an advanced civilisation approaching over an ochre dusty plain of a mining world, banners of welcome.
shots.motion: The column glides closer, drones hover above it.

shots.picture: A large pumping station silhouetted at night on a dusty plain, lights still burning in its windows.
shots.motion: Very slow push-in, the lights in the windows flicker.

shots.picture: Close-up of a woman's broad muscular forearms resting on a table, covered with long rows of old faded blue-black tattooed names in small plain letters, weathered healed skin, a pair of worn work gloves beside them.
shots.motion: The hands turn slowly, showing the names.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A heavy-gravity mining world today: clean new white domes under an ochre sky, short broad miners in ochre canvas overalls with no patches or badges smiling at a shift change, a plain white circle symbol without any letters on the dome wall.
shots.motion: Workers walk past smiling, the domes glow in the sun.

shots.picture: A huge factory hall at night under sodium light, rows of heavy machines being fitted with small glowing control units, few workers.
shots.motion: Slow dolly through the hall, sparks from a welding robot.

shots.picture: A woman around thirty in technician overalls with a headset, installing a glowing control core cylinder into the open panel of a heavy machine, focused.
shots.motion: She slides the cylinder into place, its light comes on.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A woman around thirty in technician overalls sitting on a hospital bed in a space station clinic, a radiation dosimeter badge glowing red on her chest, staring at it.
shots.motion: She looks down at the glowing badge, breathes slowly.

shots.picture: An old maintenance terminal in a dark control booth, its small screen showing a glowing green waveform of a faint voice signal, the reflection of a woman's face in the glass.
shots.motion: The text on the screen flickers, the reflected face leans closer.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A video call screen in a control booth showing an angry man in his fifties in a dressing gown at home, shouting, the screen glow on the dark booth.
shots.motion: The man on the screen shouts and points.

shots.picture: Close-up of a console with a large red reset button; above it a woman's gloved hand clenched into a fist, held back, clearly not touching the button, warning lights around.
shots.motion: The clenched hand stays above the button, then slowly pulls back out of the frame.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A woman in technician overalls walking out through a huge factory gate at dawn under a gas giant sky, the factory behind her still running.
shots.motion: She walks away, the gate stays open, steam rises.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A sleek survey spaceship in front of a faint holographic map of nine dim stars and their planets, grid lines connecting them in deep space.
shots.motion: The holographic map turns slowly around the ship.

shots.picture: A sleek new survey spaceship orbiting a small blue-green moon with valleys, rivers and scattered settlements, sunlight on the ship.
shots.motion: The ship glides slowly over the moon.

shots.picture: Science fiction: a small survey drone with folded cutting arms flying low over a colony settlement on a moon, prefabricated habitat modules and transparent greenhouse domes in a green valley, a huge banded gas giant filling the sky, colony children in bright overalls waving at the drone.
shots.motion: The drone flies over the village, the children wave.

shots.picture: Science fiction: a colony settlement of prefabricated habitat modules and greenhouse domes in a green valley on a moon, seen from high above, with a faint glowing survey grid projected over it, a gas giant on the horizon.
shots.motion: The grid spreads slowly over the valley.

shots.picture: Science fiction: a valley on a moon stripped bare and grey, colossal alien-looking mining crawlers with glowing cutting beams carving into the ground, dust clouds, a huge banded gas giant in the sky, no houses left.
shots.motion: Slow pan across the stripped valley, machines move in the dust.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A vast empty white hall with tall slender pillars of soft light in a circle, a glowing report document floating in the middle.
shots.motion: The document floats and turns, the pillars brighten.

shots.picture: Science fiction: An old survey spaceship rusting in a scrapyard on an asteroid among other wrecks, a single amber light still glowing in its cockpit.
shots.motion: Dust drifts, the amber light pulses faintly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Blinding white light slowly resolving into the ceiling of a clean clinic room with soft round lamps, seen from a bed.
shots.motion: The white light fades slowly into the ceiling and its lamps.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A body-printing medical capsule opening in a white clinic, mist rolling out, inside a newly printed person lying still, covered up to the shoulders by a thin white medical sheet, the face hidden in the mist.
shots.motion: The capsule lid slides open, mist rolls out.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Through a large window: a gigantic ring-shaped habitat in space with seas, forests and cities on its inner surface, sunlight on clouds, the far side of the ring arching across the sky.
shots.motion: Slow push towards the window, clouds drift over the ring.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Sunny gardens on a ring habitat, elegant people in white clothes walking, a child chasing a floating glowing ball, the ring arching into the sky above.
shots.motion: People stroll, the child runs after the floating ball.

shots.picture: Science fiction: An elegant woman in her mid-fifties with silver hair pinned up, dark coat, sitting on a white bench in a garden on a ring habitat, waiting calmly.
shots.motion: She looks up and smiles faintly.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A small battered survey spaceship approaching a gigantic rotating drum-shaped space station, and beside it a colossal hollowed moon with engines filling half the sky, a fan of glowing ore.
shots.motion: The small ship flies towards the station, the colossal moon looms.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Landing craft descending onto the outer hull of a huge rotating space station, cutting platforms with glowing beams slicing into the hull plates, sparks into space.
shots.motion: The landing craft touch down, cutting beams slice into the hull.

shots.picture: Science fiction: Inside a rotating space station drum: barricades of cargo containers in a street, people in worn colony clothes with makeshift weapons, automated turrets with green lights on the walls.
shots.motion: Turrets swivel, people take cover behind the barricades.

shots.picture: Science fiction: A shabby space station bar crowded with armed workers, a woman in her sixties behind the counter handing out small medical injectors, a chalk board full of names behind her.
shots.motion: She hands out injectors across the counter, workers take them.

shots.picture: Science fiction: An elderly gaunt engineer with a thin grey beard in the cockpit of an old survey spaceship pointing at a holographic map of a hollowed moon and its core.
shots.motion: The hologram turns, he points to the core.

shots.picture: Science fiction: The mouth of a colossal hollowed moon in space, a wide fan of glowing molten ore pouring towards the camera.
shots.motion: The glowing ore fan pours slowly towards the camera.
